To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the literature on GrSCH is vast and diverse.
GrSCM is an important area that needs to be researched further, and a broad frame of references is needed.

(1) the literature on GrSMC is growing rapidly; (2) the research is scattered across various journals and conferences; (3) the literature has a wide range of problem context, methodology and approach; (4) a classification is needed to understand the integrated GrSCM; and (5) the classification is needed to develop the GrSCM framework and to identify research issues and opportunities.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions: (1) What are the major influential areas of supply chain management?
the following questions: What is the state of art of GrSCM research?
the development of a framework that can be utilized by researchers and practitioners to understand the various aspects of GrSCM and to develop a better perspective of the same.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
GrSCM research has been conducted in a fragmented manner.
GrSCM has a rich literature, but it is not adequately classified to facilitate research in the area.
there is a need to develop a framework for GrSCM that can be adopted by academicians, practitioners, and policy makers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the GrSCM literature has been reviewed in an integrated and holistic manner.
the GrSCM is an emerging area and there is need for further research.
the literature is classified on the following basis: (a) problem context, (b) methodology/ approach and (c) timeline.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is a need to develop a holistic framework of GrSCM that integrates the major influential areas of GrSCM, and also to provide a comprehensive review of the literature on Gr SCM.
the area of Gr SCM is still in its infancy, and there is a need for further research to address the issues that have been highlighted.
there is a need for more research in GrSCM.
